title: Elixir projects built with Mix
description: For an Elixir project built with Mix: a committed mix.lock, warnings that fail the build, checked formatting and the Hex audit of retired and vulnerable packages.

sources.title: Elixir v1.20.5 documentation, library guidelines: mix.lock

rules.instruction: Commit `mix.lock` so that every build fetches the same dependencies, and run `mix deps.get --check-locked` in CI, which fails when the lockfile has pending changes.
rules.verification: task verify checks that `mix.lock` exists; also check that a change to the dependencies of `mix.exs` updates `mix.lock` in the same change.

rules.instruction: Compile in CI with `mix compile --warnings-as-errors`, which exits with a non-zero status when compilation has a warning, and fix each warning the change brings.
rules.verification: task verify checks that the CI configuration or `mix.exs` passes `--warnings-as-errors`; also check that the compilation of the change prints no warning.

rules.instruction: Keep the formatter's settings in `.formatter.exs` and run `mix format --check-formatted` in CI, so that unformatted code is rejected.
rules.verification: task verify checks that the CI configuration or `mix.exs` runs `--check-formatted`; also run `mix format --check-formatted` on the change.

rules.instruction: Run `mix hex.audit` in CI: it fails when a locked Hex package is retired or has a security advisory. Replace or update the package, or list it in the audit's ignores with the reason and an owner in the change.
rules.verification: Run `mix hex.audit` and check that it exits with 0, or that each ignored advisory or retirement has a reason and an owner in the change.
